verdict.rationale: ChatGPT can browse websites and fetch third-party documentation via Browser/MCP (e.g. Context7 for developer docs), and probe evidence confirms OpenAI's own docs site exposes a compact llms.txt that an agent could be pointed at. However there is no first-party feature or documentation describing llms.txt as a recognized input format that a user can explicitly hand to ChatGPT, nor hands-on confirmation that pointing ChatGPT at an llms.txt yields the intended compact-context behavior. Missing for 10: explicit product support/documentation for consuming llms.txt as a distinct agent-doc format, and independent verification that browsing/MCP actually ingests such files as intended rather than just generic web pages.
